name: iam:PassRole + cloudformation:UpdateStackSet
description: A principal with iam:PassRole and cloudformation:UpdateStackSet can escalate privileges by modifying an existing CloudFormation StackSet that has a privileged execution role. Both permissions are required—cloudformation:UpdateStackSet alone is insufficient because the UpdateStackSet API call requires passing the administration role ARN, which necessitates iam:PassRole. The attacker injects a malicious IAM role into the StackSet template and passes the administration role ARN. CloudFormation's execution role provisions the new admin IAM role across all stack instances. The attacker then assumes that role for full admin access.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must have permission to pass the administration role to CloudFormation StackSets
Must have permission to update the target CloudFormation StackSet

additional.description: View StackSet details and retrieve current template
List stack instances to confirm deployment targets
Verify the escalated role was created by the StackSet update

admin: A CloudFormation StackSet must exist that the principal can update
The StackSet must have an execution role with administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess)
The StackSet must have at least one stack instance deployed
lateral: A CloudFormation StackSet must exist that the principal can update
The StackSet must have an execution role with elevated permissions to create the desired resources
The StackSet must have deployed stack instances

references.title: AWS IAM Privilege Escalation - Methods and Mitigation (Rhino Security Labs)

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: STACKSET_NAME
options.description: Name of the existing CloudFormation StackSet with an admin execution role

options.name: ADMIN_ROLE_ARN
options.description: ARN of the administration role to pass to CloudFormation StackSets (requires iam:PassRole). Leave blank to auto-construct from account ID using the lab's default role name

options.name: EXECUTION_ROLE_NAME
options.description: Name of the execution role used by the StackSet in target accounts

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for CloudFormation and IAM operations

options.name: ASSUME_ROLE
options.description: Attempt to assume the escalated role after the StackSet update completes

options.name: PAYLOAD
options.description: Payload type for the CloudFormation StackSet template injection (backdoor/attach-policy)

options.name: ESCALATED_ROLE_NAME
options.description: Name for the escalated IAM role to create (auto-generated if empty)

options.name: TRUST_PRINCIPAL
options.description: ARN to trust in the escalated role's trust policy (defaults to caller ARN)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Revert the StackSet to its original template after execution. Requires cloudformation:UpdateStackSet with the admin role

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with AdministratorAccess trusted by the attacker's principal via CloudFormation template
